summary: BlackRock TCP Capital Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of Philip Tseng as Director, Board Chair, CEO, and Co-Chief Investment Officer effective August 31, 2026, to pursue other opportunities, with no disagreement cited. Jason Mehring, previously President, was appointed Director, Board Chair, and CEO effective September 2, 2026. Tseng remains an employee until October 1, 2026, for transition. No deal terms, prices, or advisors are mentioned. The abrupt leadership transition, though amicable, constitutes a special-situation management change. The board's orderly succession plan signals continuity; monitor integration, transition effectiveness, and any strategic pivots.
